decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed alterations and additions to New Chiswick Pool, as shown on drawings 200 PA 01, 200 PA 02, 200 PA 11, 200 PA 12, 200 PA 61 and 50 PA 61; received 7 April 2009, comprising a part ground floor, part first floor and two-storey extension to provide additional and enhance leisure facilities, new gates and fences, and car park improvements; are satisfactory as they would enhance the existing leisure and recreation facilities and improve access to them and ancillary caf? and child care services. Subject to acceptable details of external finishes be submitted and approved, the proposal would result in a high quality building that would make efficient use of the site and be compatible with its surrounds and the street scene, and is appropriate for its use as a public leisure facility. The development also incorporates environmentally sustainable measures including on-site renewable energy, 'brown roofs' and rainwater reuse. The development would not be likely to result in harm to local traffic and parking conditions as it is served by a number of modes of transport that provide sustainable access to the site, including public transport and the existing parking arrangements deter excessive car use. Subject to safeguarding conditions that are recommended, there would not be harmful impacts on the local environment, including the living conditions of nearby residents. Accordingly approval is recommended. The development therefore complies with the relevant policies of the Development Plan, including ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), ENV-1.5 (Environmental Improvements), C.4.3 (Physical Access to Social and Community Facilities), C.5.2 (Existing Indoor Recreation Facilities), andT.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan; and policies 3A.18 (Protection and enhancement of social infrastructure and community facilities), 3D.6 (The Olympic and Paralympic Games and sports fac
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials and finishes to be used in the construction of all the external surfaces of the hereby permitted building have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until full details of hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and works shall be carried out as approved before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied. Details shall include means of enclosure, boundary fencing/walls, external lighting, vehicle and pedestrian access areas, planting plans and specifications and an implementation programme.

Condition : 6 - In this condition "retained tree" means an existing tree which is to be retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars; and paragraphs (a) and (b) below shall have effect until the expiration of (5 years?) from (the date of the occupation of the building for its permitted use).

(a) No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the written approval of the local planning authority.  Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard [BS 3998:1989].

(b) If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the local planning authority.

(c) The erection of fencing for the protection of any retained tree shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved plans and particulars before any equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the development, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site.  Nothing shall be stored or placed in any area fenced in accordance with this condition and the ground levels within those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavation be made, without the written consent of the local planning authority.

Condition : 7 - No development shall take place until an Arboricultural Method Statement has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing in respect of all trees to be retained in order to ensure their ongoing health during construction and other works associated for the development hereby approved. All work shall be carried out in accordance with the approved statement.

Condition : 8 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority. All plant shall be designed to achieve a level of 10dB below the existing LA90 background noise level at 3.5m from the fa?ade of the nearest residences or commercial property.

Condition : 9 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm o Mondays to Fridays, 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays, with no work to take place on Sundays and Bank Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 10 - No development shall be commenced until details of a 'Living Wall' providing a green wall with vegetation covering the majority of the vertical timber cladding of the southeast elevation of the first floor of the building are submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA. The details shall be carried out as approved prior to the occupation of the first floor extension hereby approved.

Condition : 11 - No development shall take place until details of a Sustainable Drainage Scheme, including measures for living roofs and/or walls, harvesting of rainwater, the minimisation of water run-off from the site, aiming for greenfield levels, and the conservation and reuse as appropriate of other water supplies in the building have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall be carried out as approved prior to the occupation of the first floor extension hereby approved.

Condition : 12 - No development shall take place until details have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, for a scheme of reducing carbon emissions from the total energy needs (heat, cooling and power) of the development by at least 20%, by the on-site generation of renewable energy. The details shall be carried out as approved prior to the occupation of the first floor extension hereby approved.

Condition : 14 - No development shall take place until full details of the lift access to the first floor, including its means of control, are submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall be carried out as approved prior to the occupation of the first floor extension hereby approved.
description: Part ground floor, part first floor and part two storey extension to accommodate new gym facilities, new gates and fences and resurfacing of car park area.
